title: Non-EU citizen with Hungarian student card

turns.user: I'm a non-EU citizen attending university in Budapest. Am I automatically excluded from the student pass?
turns.agent:
No—not automatically, if you have a valid Hungarian higher-education student ID. The 5 November 2026 knowledge snapshot says that this ID type can satisfy the student-ID requirement without a citizenship restriction. But that alone does not establish full eligibility; other requirements, including programme type and a valid student ID, still apply.

The citizenship and registered-Hungarian-address conditions in the snapshot concern accepted foreign EU/EEA/Swiss or ISIC IDs. If that’s the ID you rely on rather than a Hungarian higher-education student ID, your non-EU citizenship may matter. Don’t share your address or ID details here.

For the applicable criteria, see BKK’s Monthly Budapest pass for students and 2026 changes for international students. This is based on a static snapshot, not a live verification; check BKK’s current terms before relying on it.
